source_refs.title: Free up drive space in Windows | Microsoft Support
source_refs.section: Free up space with Cleanup recommendations
source_refs.applicability: Windows 11 (the page also covers Windows 10; this ref is for Windows 11)
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Select Start > Settings > System > Storage > Cleanup recommendations.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Windows 11: Select Start > Settings > System > Storage > Cleanup recommendations. Review the categories Temporary files, Large or unused files, Files synced to the cloud, and Unused apps. Choose the items you want to remove. Windows suggests files and shows how much space each cleanup would recover. After making your selections, click the Clean up button in each section. If you upgraded Windows fewer than 10 days ago, your previous version appears as a deletable system file. Deleting it removes the Windows.old folder, which contains files that give you the option to go back to your previous version of Windows. If you delete your previous version of Windows, this can't be undone.

source_refs.section: Clean up space with Google One Storage Manager
source_refs.applicability: Google Account storage on a computer
source_refs.model_visible_text: On a computer: Select Clean up space. Under 'Clean up suggested items' or 'Clean up by service,' click a category or service you want to review.
